cases.sentence: Вот в чем вопрос! – проговорил торжественно Петрицкий, проводя кверху от носа ___.
cases.explain: «указательным пальцем» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “Where are they? That’s just the question!” said Petritsky solemnly, moving his forefinger upwards from his nose.

cases.sentence: Он так и заснул на крыше под ___.
cases.explain: «погребальный марш» — after the preposition «под», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Oh, didn’t we make a pretty finish!” said Petritsky. “Volkov climbed onto the roof and began telling us how sad he was. I said: ‘Let’s have music, the funeral march!’ He fairly dropped asleep on the roof over the funeral march.”

cases.sentence: Он весело засмеялся, показывая свои ___, и, надвинув фуражку на лысину, вышел и сел в коляску.
cases.explain: «сплошные зубы» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Vronsky was in fact beginning, prematurely, to get a little bald. He laughed gaily, showing his even teeth, and pulling his cap over the thin place, went out and got into his carriage.
